note: A pattern may belong to multiple classifiers (e.g. redos-suspect is cross-cutting).

secret-detection.description: Patterns that detect credentials, API keys, private keys, bearer tokens and other secrets. risk_class=catastrophic; misuse or removal is a security event.

pii-detection.description: Patterns that match personally identifiable information (email, SSN, phone, IBAN, DOB). risk_class=sensitive; governed by privacy/de-identification policy.

path-traversal.description: Patterns encoding directory-traversal / path-escape shapes (../ , %2e%2e). Defensive detectors; risk_class=catastrophic when used to guard filesystem access.

path-validation.description: Path / filesystem-locator validators that are not traversal detectors.

hash-digest-identifier.description: Content-digest identifiers (sha256/sha1/blake hex, e.g. ^[a-f0-9]{64}$, sha256: prefixes). Backbone of the estate's receipt/provenance layer.

identifier-slug.description: Governed id/slug/IRI shapes (ds., src., rx., urn:, uuid, cell IRIs).

schema-field-validation.description: JSON-Schema `pattern` field validators governing contract/manifest fields.

generic-validation.description: Anchored / character-class / bounded structural validators not covered by a more specific classifier.

uncategorized.description: Patterns not yet assigned a semantic category — candidate backlog for curation.

redos-suspect.description: CROSS-CUT quality set: patterns with nested-quantifier / catastrophic-backtracking shapes. GAPS — each should be reviewed and, if user-input-facing, replaced or bounded. File as issues.
